Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by oil prices and rising rates, which is a headwind for growth names. My kind of tech/chip stocks are feeling the pinch.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.8%) and SPAL (-37.89%) are the big pain points, both leveraged ETFs that are bleeding. QQQ (-1.42%) and SMH (-14.81%) are also under pressure. CRWD (34.81%) is your lone bright spot.

Watch: Keep an eye on Intel (INTC) news, as chip sentiment can be contagious.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting capital in this choppy environment.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming if it breaks below its current price, given its leveraged nature and significant loss.
QQQ: Respect the stop at 670; a break lower could signal further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch
